split_rule: Per target and replicate, randomly permute sorted public Soil_IDs without labels. Reserve min(n-max_budget,max(4,ceil(.35*n))) audit soils. Reveal a single nested prefix of remaining soils at every feasible budget; all other labels remain unused.
source_rule: Exclude the complete target study and every source row sharing a public Soil_ID with any target row, including unselected target soils.
